selection_rationale: C2026-001 directly tests a core, operationally meaningful gap (verifier-guided vs generator-only repair under telemetry faults) that maps to established findings CG1/CG2 and EF3 (validator+LLM architectures improve reliability). It is experimentally falsifiable, statistically clear (paired per-task design), feasible within the stated model-call budget, and highly relevant to the CNSM Agentic AI Researcher track. Key supporting records: https://openalex.org/W7157506260, https://openalex.org/W7163413045, https://openalex.org/W7202179524, https://openalex.org/W7161354925, https://openalex.org/W7106650998.
unresolved_uncertainties: Generalization to large-scale, heterogeneous production topologies and multi-vendor environments (UQ1: https://openalex.org/W7157506260; https://openalex.org/W4408567138).
Which evaluation metrics and validator/canary protocols best map to real operational safety across NetOps tasks (UQ2: https://openalex.org/W7106650998; doi:10.3390/app16073583).
Risk of validator-evasion or specification-gaming by generator/self-correction loops (UQ3: https://openalex.org/W4409346645; doi:10.2139/ssrn.6512960).
Sensitivity of outcomes to prompt framing and run-to-run stochasticity (UQ4: https://openalex.org/W4406779522; doi:10.32388/be0zbc).
Validator coverage gaps and their attribution (generator error vs validator weakness) in measured unsafe-apply rates.
required_repairs_before_preregistration: Characterize and validate deterministic-validator coverage with unit tests and known-failure injections (measure false-negative/false-positive rates).
Add a multi-iteration repair arm (vs single automated iteration) and preregister iteration limits; report cost/latency tradeoffs.
Broaden or justify representativeness of the synthetic task bank (document generation rules, vendor templates, and include multi-vendor syntactic templates).
Preregister precise pairing/ordering and randomness-control protocol for model calls; log model settings, temperatures, request ordering, and any seeds; ensure stateless isolation between runs.
Specify blinded, repeatable criteria for labeling regressions and unsafe-apply outcomes; preregister labeling procedures and any adjudication/reconciliation steps.
